summary: Regression tested P2 (drop announcement generator: template + AI rewrite for LinkedIn/X/Instagram/Facebook) and P3 (marketplace curation: featured toggle + admin category CRUD). 10/10 backend pytest cases pass. Web UI verified end-to-end: /launch-admin Drops tab exposes la-announce-toggle/panel/tabs/text/copy/ai testids and populates 4 platform templates including the DEVOS100 code and URL; AI rewrite button is present and clickable (LLM response returned within timeout window in one run). /templates renders the Featured section with the Featured badge and category filter pills. /market/review shows both categories-card and featured-card; category creation via UI works end-to-end (toast confirmed, backend row created).

issues: React hydration warning in console: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>'. Comes from the visual-editor overlay wrapping the numeric option value in a <span>; harmless at runtime but noisy in prod console. Consider stringifying the option value or suppressing the overlay for <option> children.

Category filter pills do NOT expose a data-testid like tm-cat-tab-<slug>. Zero matches for [data-testid^='tm-cat-tab-'] — recommend adding stable testids so future automation can click each category tab reliably (spec calls this out under P3 UI public).

action_items: (Optional/nice-to-have) Add data-testid='tm-cat-tab-<slug>' to each category filter pill on /templates so parity of the P3 UI spec bullet is complete.
(Optional) Fix hydration warning by rendering <option value={String(n)}>{n}</option> in LaunchAdmin.jsx around line 95 to avoid the visual-editor wrapping the child in a <span>.
critical_code_review_comments: template_market.py:183 has an awkward truthiness idiom: `"files": {f['path']: f for f in files} and list({f['path']: f for f in files}.values())` — builds the dedup dict twice and relies on truthiness. Simplify to `list({f['path']: f for f in files}.values())`.
drop_announce.py: parsing wrapper for AI JSON is resilient and falls back to templates on any exception — good pattern.
template_market.py:452 (create_category) properly slug-normalizes and dedupes on slug; PATCH endpoint returns {'ok': True} even when no fields provided instead of 400 — minor UX nit.
